rationale: Motor vehicle collision with totaled vehicle and injury to policyholder; clearly an auto claim.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 yesterday morning at approximately 8:15am by another vehicle traveling at 35 mph without braking. The policyholder's vehicle is totaled with the trunk crushed into the back seat. Pat has sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist; the other driver's insurance information is available on the police report.

case_facts.description: Rear-ended at red light by other vehicle traveling approximately 35 mph without braking; entire trunk crushed into back seat
